label: Странный / Обычный
description: Странный vs обычный: strange/ordinary contrasts across genders and everyday scenes.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Masculine nominative agreement. 'Странный' takes the masculine ending to match 'голос'. The sentence frames the oddness in a natural descriptive context.
Strategic focus: Feminine nominative agreement. 'Обычная' takes the feminine ending to match 'история'. The form is anchored in an ordinary everyday remark.
Strategic focus: Neuter nominative agreement. 'Странное' takes the neuter ending to match 'чувство'. The sentence shows the learner switching endings inside a feeling-state description.
Strategic focus: Masculine nominative agreement. 'Обычный' takes the masculine ending to match 'день'. The form sits in a simple statement about routine.

missions.phrase: Это странный человек, но обычная семья.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Contrast across two genders. 'Странный' matches masculine 'человек' while 'обычная' matches feminine 'семья'. The sentence pairs both endings in one contrasting judgement.
Strategic focus: Plural nominative agreement. 'Странные' takes the plural ending to match 'звуки'. The sentence applies the adjective to a plural noun in an atmospheric scene.
Strategic focus: Plural nominative agreement. 'Обычные' takes the plural ending to match 'книги'. The sentence reinforces the plural form in a plain household setting.
Strategic focus: Neuter short form. 'Странно' is the predicative short form agreeing with neuter 'поведение'. The sentence shows the short form stating a judged quality rather than naming a thing.

missions.phrase: Этот случай страннее, чем обычная ошибка.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Comparative versus full adjective. 'Страннее' is the comparative form set against the full adjective 'обычная', which agrees with feminine 'ошибка'. The sentence contrasts a comparative with a plain attributive use.

missions.phrase: Сначала вопрос странный, а потом обычный.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Direct masculine contrast. 'Странный' and 'обычный' both take the masculine ending to match 'вопрос'. The sentence pairs the two adjectives in one shift of perception.
